Definition: properly, to be naught, i.e. (figuratively) to be (causatively, act) light
BiblicalUsage: hûwn means to be naught, to act foolishly. It appears in Deuteronomy, and each time it carries that same plain sense.
TheologicalSignificance: I take hûwn as it stands: to be naught, to act foolishly.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
